title: /api/project-overview
responsibility: Returns the privacy-filtered tracker overview to requests from the local Explorer owner.

inputs.name: GET.event
inputs.description: The SvelteKit request and peer address checked by the Explorer owner policy.

outputs.name: GET
outputs.description: A no-store JSON snapshot with status 200, or an unavailable body with status 403 or 503.

errors.description: The request failed the local owner and same-origin checks. The tracker is not read.
The local tracker could not produce a valid snapshot.
